title: Context
description: A principal's (user/team/org) context profile carrying only the minimum durable information needed for personalization, routing, and policy - identity, role, memberships, working context, and approval limits, NOT raw conversation logs. Personal memory is kept separate from org knowledge and PII is minimized and flagged via `data_classification`. Canonical shape from the Synapse design report; backs the Context Service and the POST /context.upsert endpoint.

principal_id.description: Stable identifier of the principal (user or agent) this context describes. Also carried at request time via the X-Principal-Id header.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant/organization. Tenant boundaries are enforced in storage and query plans (row-level security), not only in UI logic.

team_ids.description: Team/group memberships the principal belongs to; used for team-scoped retrieval and access.

role.description: Platform/business role used for RBAC decisions.

location.description: Coarse working location (e.g. country/region) for routing and data-residency policy.

approval_limit_usd.description: Maximum monetary value (USD) the principal may approve autonomously before human sign-off is required.

preferred_tools.description: Tools/connectors the principal prefers, used to bias routing.

active_projects.description: Current workspace/project scopes the principal is working within.

policy_overrides.description: Explicit policy overrides applied to this principal (named flags or structured rules), e.g. requiring human approval for wire changes.

data_classification.description: Data-classification flags that drive PII handling and retention for this context.

contains_pii.description: True if this context contains personally identifiable information.

special_category.description: True if this context contains special-category / sensitive personal data requiring stricter safeguards.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last update to this context profile.
